Description:
[center][font=Courier New]This is my first clothing mod ^^ 

[b][u][size=3]1.2 UPDATE: Added one new head piece (hat)[/size][/u][/b]

Do you want to wear a cute baby doll dress? 
Or do you want a cute apron dress?
This mod is perfect for anyone looking for soft dresses to adventure in!

Adds 9 new shirts and skirts to the fashion sense menu, they work best as a set to create 9 different cute dresses.

The sleeves are from Lia's female spring body but you can use any sleeve mod you like.
